question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word:

 LUMINOUS
solution:
The correct answer is: **Dim**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Luminous"** means emitting or reflecting light; something that is bright or shining. (प्रकाशमान, चमकीला)
 
 
• **Example:** The moon was luminous in the night sky, casting a soft glow over the landscape.
 
 
• **"Dim"** refers to something that is not bright, faint, or not clearly visible. It is the opposite of luminous. (मद्धिम, फीका)
 
 
• **Example:** The room was dimly lit, making it hard to read the book.
